info.title: Kobe API
info.description: Team-scoped routes act on the session's active team (spec D9); send X-Kobe-Team on changes. Errors are `{code, message}`. Authentication is the Better Auth session cookie.

get.summary: List the viewer's threads (or a project's readable threads), newest first
get.description: Keyset pagination on (last_activity_at, id). Never Trash. With `q`, full-text search (KOBE-33): web-search syntax (`"phrase"`, `-exclude`, `or`) over user/assistant messages (all terms in one message) and titles (plus fuzzy title matching), ranked by relevance with snippets; `cursor` is then a search cursor and `limit` is capped at 50. Reads Postgres only (never wakes a sandbox).

parameters.name: X-Kobe-Team
parameters.description: The team the client believes is active. Required on changes; must match.

200.description: A page of threads (`ThreadSearchPage` when `q` is given).

409.description: `no_active_team` or `team_mismatch` (stale tab), or a thread conflict.

503.description: `search_timeout`: the search exceeded its time limit.
